about:
JPW Machining LLC operates a CNC machine shop in Kent, Ohio, serving the manufacturing industry. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The shop specializes in billet CNC machining and the production of complex mold components for area tooling shops. Its technical capabilities and skills allow it to produce a complete range of products designed and machined to customer specifications, working from customer-provided designs to deliver finished machined parts. The work encompasses both billet machining from solid stock and the intricate machining required for mold tooling. Information on facility size, headcount, production volumes, or part numbers is not provided.

The company serves the broader manufacturing industry, with a noted focus on tooling shops that require complex mold components. Customer types include manufacturers needing custom-machined parts, though no specific industry sectors or client names are listed.

The company has not published a specific statement on what sets it apart or why it was founded.
